claim: Indie hacker spends 2 hours every month manually sending invoices to customers
paraphrased_evidence: A founder described manually generating and emailing PDF invoices each month because Stripe's invoicing feature doesn't support their local tax requirements. They spend about 2 hours on this repetitive task.

claim: Indie hacker manually tags each support ticket into categories
paraphrased_evidence: A solo founder complained that their helpdesk (Intercom) doesn't auto-categorize tickets, so they manually read and assign category labels every day. They estimate 15-30 minutes daily wasted on this.

claim: Indie hacker spends 30 minutes each week manually formatting newsletter content
paraphrased_evidence: A content creator described copying blog post HTML into Mailchimp and spending significant time adjusting formatting, images, and links. They wish there was an automated way to sync content.

claim: Indie hacker uses a spreadsheet to manually track affiliate commissions
paraphrased_evidence: A founder running an affiliate program said they rely on a Google Sheet to record affiliate sign-ups, sales, and calculate commissions because their platform lacks built-in affiliate tracking. They spend hours each month reconciling.

claim: Indie hacker manually calculates churn from Stripe exports each month
paraphrased_evidence: A SaaS founder described exporting subscription data from Stripe to Excel every month to manually compute churn rate and cohort retention. They noted this is error-prone and delays their ability to act on churn signals.
